notes: Nothing eligible confirmed for Puerto Rico. No Puerto Rican food-truck or own-ordering tool found; search results were marketplaces (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Postmates — never counted), single-restaurant apps (Meso Pick-Up, built on Flipdish [agent 1]; FoodNetPR; Taco Bell PR) and a Zegashop guide (stored candidate; Indian, agent 2). Square: its own availability page excludes PR. Toast: a PR merchant ordering page on toasttab.com exists but answered 403, and Toast's site does not state PR coverage — a reviewer could check Toast's US pricing page if PR (USD) is to be counted. DoorDash's Storefront/online ordering is a marketplace's product and not counted. US tools stored in compare-research-1 (Hotplate, Goodfynd, etc.) were not re-checked for PR coverage.
